scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using TMDB/IMDb to MAL/AniList identity mapping and Re:ANIME's structured Flix API. DUB prefers direct MKV; SUB preserves the exact FlixCloud HLS audio variant. Includes soft subtitle extraction, distinct mirror labels, and exact TMDB/IMDb verification for anime-movie fallback matching.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on maintained Re:ANIME and FlixCloud reference implementations
